$comment: Everything the shared pipeline needs and cannot detect. The pipeline itself is identical across every repository that uses it; this file is the only thing that differs.

identity.description: Odborná práce: autonomní pipeline pro vývoj softwaru (GJKT)

upstream.$comment: Consumer of the DarkFactory pipeline; pin to a commit SHA once the paper domain has landed upstream.

environment.$comment: The paper is one Typst project with template-neutral manuscript semantics in templates/common.typ, selection in templates/registry.typ, and switchable document templates under templates/<name>/. CI builds the canonical eight PDFs plus a complete eight-output matrix for every discovered template, validates architecture, and Pages exposes every template/profile/review combination. Release assets remain the canonical default-template eight PDFs.

ci.description: GitHub Actions workflows a automatizace repozitáře

board.$comment: Items land on this repository's own board and on the board aggregating every repository.

license.$comment: Written from GitHub's canonical text, so it cannot drift from the wording it claims to be. NONE means deliberately not licensed for reuse, which is different from having forgotten to choose. Change it through a configuration issue.

$comment_required_checks: Written rather than defaulted: calling the pipeline as a reusable workflow prefixes every check with the caller's job name, so the unprefixed defaults would protect the branch against contexts nothing reports.
